name: run_linter
description: Run static linters for Generate-stage source (fortitude/cppcheck/ruff/mixed). Does not use build_system or compile_project; preset-only, no custom command.

command_log_path.description: JSONL path for command logs. Relative paths are resolved from project_dir.

env.description: Environment overrides for the command. Under an orchestration only OBJDIR, BINDIR, RUNDIR, BIN, SPEC, CASES are accepted; any other key is refused. Standalone, keys that redirect execution (LD_*, DYLD_*, PATH, PYTHONPATH, BASH_ENV, ENV, IFS, COMPILER_PATH, GCC_EXEC_PREFIX, LIBRARY_PATH, MAKEFLAGS, GNUMAKEFLAGS, MAKEFILES, MAKESHELL) are refused.

orchestration_id.description: Required under the workflow (METDSL_ORCHESTRATION_ID set, or METDSL_WORKFLOW_MODE set to anything but 0, in the server's environment): with agent_run_id and capability_token it enforces preflight, record-launch artifacts, phase_state child_running, and capability permissions. Omitting it is refused, not exempted.

agent_run_id.description: Child agent_run_id that owns the capability token.

repo_root.description: Repository root containing workspace/orchestrations/. Defaults to project_dir.
